# AI Happy Design

> CLI tool that gives LLMs full Figma canvas control via WebSocket relay to Figma plugin.

Current release: `v0.13.2`
Command surface: 184 schema-backed commands.

## Quick Start

1. Install: `brew install nerveband/tap/ahd-figma` or `ahd-figma upgrade`
2. Register with your AI editor: `ahd-figma register`
3. Open Figma plugin, connect to relay
4. Execute: `ahd-figma batch '[{"command":"slide","params":{...}}]'`

## Key Commands

- `batch` — Execute design operations from JSON (main LLM path)
- `command` — Execute single operation
- `schema <command> --json` — Full JSON schema for a command (types, enums, min/max)
- `schema --json` — All 184 command schemas as JSON array
- `validate` — Dry-run: check JSON without executing
- `guide` — Design intelligence (visual hierarchy, composition, effects)
- `tools --json` — List all commands with schemas
- `tokens.export` — Export deterministic presets or Figma variable snapshots to JSON, CSS, Tailwind, Swift, or Android
- `document.accessibility_audit` — WCAG-oriented design checks for text, contrast, targets, naming, and focus risk
- `parity.compare_code` — Compare design intent against a code-spec contract before implementation
- `examples [category]` — Pre-built example payloads (slide, carousel, banner, effects)
- `status` — Relay health, plugin connection, version mismatch detection

## Agent-Optimized Flags

- `command --dry-run` — Validate params against schema without executing
- `batch --dry-run` — Validate full payloads before touching Figma
- `--output-format json|jsonl|text` — Machine-friendly output control
- `--jq .path[0].value` — Extract a simple JSON field path before printing
- `--fields id,name,type` — Return only specified fields where supported

## Safety & Hardening

- Schema validation with fuzzy matching and auto-correction
- Input hardening: control chars, path traversal, prompt injection sanitization
- Output path sandboxing (exports restricted to safe directories)
- Safety metadata: `readOnly`, `destructive`, `idempotent` on every schema
- `commitUndo()` on all write operations (Cmd+Z in Figma)
- Structured errors with `code`, `hint`, `retryable` fields
- Differentiated exit codes: 0=success, 1=error, 2=relay, 3=plugin, 4=validation

## Design Workflow

1. `ahd-figma command design.compute_tokens '{"width":1080,"height":1350}'`
2. `ahd-figma command document.find_free_space '{"width":1080,"height":1350}'`
3. `ahd-figma schema <command> --json` to discover params
4. `ahd-figma batch ops.json`
5. `ahd-figma command export.image '{"nodeId":"...","scale":2}'`

## Response Detail Levels

Read commands support `detail` param: `minimal` (id/name/type), `compact` (+ position/size), `full` (everything).

## MCP Integration

- `ahd-figma mcp` — stdio MCP server with 4 design intelligence prompts
- MCP tools/list exposes 185 tools including `ahd_describe`
- `ahd-figma register` — auto-configures Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code, Zed

## Scores

- Agent CLI Audit: 50/50 (Best-in-class)
- Agent DX CLI Scale: 21/21 (Agent-first, max)
